content.value:
What's inside

A CKEditor 5 sample project supporting the four CKEditor challenges at MLH Global Hack Week: Beginners Week (August 2025): create a starter with Builder, migrate it to TypeScript, add template functionality, and hook up CKInspector. Each challenge builds on the previous one, taking a first-time integrator from zero to a customized editor.
